description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Syr Vondam triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodsoaked Champion enters, Davvol triggers, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
